name: lix42
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by lix42

plugins.name: eng-records
plugins.description: Automatically records engineering sessions and generates review documents

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: Plan and track development work as per-task files with frontmatter status and dependencies, queried and updated by a bundled CLI that generates docs/TASKS.md, with optional epics for large plans

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Finish a coding task and ship it: quality gates, code review, mark task done, then open a PR or merge back linearly

plugins.name: pr-panel
plugins.description: Live panel for the GitHub PRs a session opens: checks, reviews, unresolved threads and comments, with auto-merge, merge, re-run and fix-this actions
